implemented.verification: single asynchronous Detect per provider, 30 second deadline, bounded submit wait queue, generation and captured environment fingerprint fence
implemented.pre_dispatch: default three attempts in 30 seconds, maximum three in 60 seconds; only typed not-started transient spawn/probe/slot failures; first normal workspace preparation pauses elapsed accounting without resetting remaining budget and uses cancellable assignment lifetime
implemented.ready_acknowledgement: locally proven unstarted claim retained before asynchronous Ready; original lease heartbeat and cancellation stay active; same lease-scoped deterministic Ready payload/key at most three supervisor attempts within 30 seconds, transient errors only; validate durable identity ACK before dispatch; exhaustion/permanent failure produces terminal report; late obsolete claim completion cannot revive work
implemented.circuit: provider plus capability fingerprint scope, two failures opens for one second, atomically one half-open owner, provider completion closes; at most 64 tracked scopes
implemented.failover: at most one explicitly server-approved provider/model handoff before dispatch; no native resume/session crossing, provider-specific environment/args/MCP rejected; neutral source instructions regenerated and same prepared directory retained
implemented.authorization: synchronous bounded Riido log acknowledgement before attempts and switches; current assignment lease/device/runtime checked by backend, temporary lease token never persisted
implemented.lease: original claim runtime retains assignment heartbeat ownership; target native runtime does not renew the same execution under another lease
implemented.outcome: dispatch is started, never recovered; first-attempt protocol completion stays dispatched/confirmed; only successful retry/handoff is recovered, and neither establishes host semantic completion
implemented.cancellation: task cancellation and deadline win during probe/admission/backoff/switch; admission context is distinct from the admitted execution context; cancellation watchers retain the original claim context and only the supervisor can cancel a matching current claim, never a replacement sharing its task ID
implemented.model_rejection: Codex model_not_found or unsupported_model errors and the exact ChatGPT-account unsupported-model diagnostic terminate as blocked/check-provider; generic 400/auth/transport failures are not inferred to be model rejection; no automatic replay or fallback after process start

never_automatic: replay of any dispatched failure or unknown outcome
process restart due solely to failed health probe
journal: bounded RecoveryContext on existing Riido log events with deterministic assignment/run/attempt/state/provider/switch idempotency key and terminal metadata; no raw prompt/error/path/argv/token diagnostics
restart: existing active assignment without durable native session remains skipped; no fresh recovery replay after daemon state loss
tests: preflight retry same workspace and finite budget
explicit fallback model and neutral instruction isolation
normal default-policy 31-second workspace clone completes without consuming provider budget
Ready HTTP retry exhaustion then restored connectivity dispatches once
Ready acknowledgement loss, cancellation, stop, drift, finite retry and obsolete completion fences
obsolete cancellation watch completion cannot cancel a replacement claim with the same execution ID
Codex unsupported model errors are blocked, native transient retries stay warnings, and ordinary auth/transport errors are not model rejections
limits: deterministic fixture validation does not prove current real provider accounts or model quality
native host checks retain existing explicit host binding and continuation limits

loop.observation: Synchronous Detect can block cancellation, and execution failures lack a safe replay boundary.
loop.hypothesis: Generation-fenced asynchronous probes and typed not-started failures permit finite recovery without replaying uncertain work.
loop.execute: Run fixture process failures, explicit approved fallback, cancellation and circuit contention tests.
loop.evaluate: Require bounded attempts/deadline/scope count, unchanged workspace and original lease; reject any replay after dispatch.
loop.retrospective: Only the tested pre-dispatch subset is implemented. Real account/model behavior and post-dispatch repair remain independent evidence.

verification_fixture_synchronization: Recovery cancellation acceptance waits for cancellation-watch registration and holds the first backoff journal boundary until cancellation is observed. Buffered progress is not a current-state barrier. The timer wait cancellation is tested separately; production recovery timing and retry limits are unchanged. Fallback ownership assertions wait for the supervisor Running lifecycle event: a child spawn notification may arrive before the claim wave returns and publishes its ownership snapshot. The Running event is emitted only after that publication; the original runtime ownership assertion remains unchanged.
